lead.event: Haji Isam acquires Low Tuck Kwong’s 30.25% BYAN stake
lead.headline: Haji Isam completes acquisition of 30.25% BYAN stake
lead.blurb: Jhonlin Baratama bought 10.08 billion Bayan Resources shares from Dato' Low Tuck Kwong and Elaine Low at Rp2,588 per share. Agreed on 16 September, the sale was completed on 7 October for approximately Rp26.1 trillion. Low said it was a pure business negotiation and that no party pressured him.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to lead

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Medco issues US$300 million bonds through Medco Redwood Tree
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MEDC issues US$300 million bonds through Medco Redwood Tree
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: The bonds carry an 8.875% coupon and mature in 2032, with Medco guaranteeing the offering. Proceeds will refinance or repay existing debt.

market_structure_policy.event: BEI plans to delist 18 issuers on November 10, 2026
market_structure_policy.headline: BEI plans to delist 18 issuers on 10 November
market_structure_policy.blurb: The group comprises seven bankrupt firms and 11 issuers suspended for more than 50 months; none completed the required buybacks by 9 November. Public investors hold 8.16 billion Sri Rejeki Isman shares, or 39.89%.
market_structure_policy.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from lead to story

other.event: IKN signs new investor agreements for housing and private investment projects
other.headline: IKN signs housing and private investment agreements worth Rp3.74 trillion
other.blurb: The Nusantara Capital Authority signed the agreements on 14 October for an eight-tower ASN apartment project worth Rp2.629 trillion and five private investments totaling around Rp3.74 trillion. Intiland (DILD) separately signed on 6 October for 109 ASN row houses worth Rp2.819 trillion, with completion targeted for Q4 2028.

earnings_guidance.event: Martina Berto returns to profit in the first nine months of 2026
earnings_guidance.headline: MBTO returns to profit with Rp19.41 billion nine-month net income
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sales rose 29.11% to Rp379.99 billion, while operating profit reached Rp38.08 billion from a Rp3.52 billion loss a year earlier. Martina Berto said founder Martha Tilaar’s death on 14 October had no negative impact on operations, financial condition or business continuity.

earnings_guidance.event: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS and cuts its target price
earnings_guidance.headline: Mirae Asset downgrades BRMS to hold and cuts target price 59.2% to Rp 310
earnings_guidance.blurb: Analyst Fauzan Luthfi Djamal cited a revised valuation for long-term projects using a higher discount rate to reflect elevated Indonesia risk, and said forecast growth is already priced in. BRMS also faces potential index demotion in the 12 November review.

earnings_guidance.event: Samuel Sekuritas projects TINS’s 2026 dividend at Rp336 per share
earnings_guidance.headline: Samuel Sekuritas projects TINS 2026 dividend at Rp336 per share
earnings_guidance.blurb: Timah posted nine-month 2026 net profit of Rp4.1 trillion, up 584.1% year on year. Samuel Sekuritas bases its estimate on Rp5 trillion in full-year profit and a 50% payout ratio, implying a 9.2% yield at Rp3,660, versus Rp88 per share for 2025.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: moved from flash to story

earnings_guidance.headline: INTP reports 22.5% higher nine-month profit at Rp1.30 trillion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Indocement's net revenue rose 8.9% to Rp14.07 trillion, while cement and clinker sales volume increased 9% to 15.75 million tons in the nine months to 30 September. It warned that high energy costs, foreign-exchange volatility and the coming rainy season could pressure margins and demand.
